# Jesus Feeds Five Thousand (Matthew 14:20)

## Emotional Focus
When there seems to be not enough and Jesus makes plenty.

## Key KJV
“And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.” (Matthew 14:20)

## Gentle Retelling
A little boy gave Jesus his lunch. Jesus blessed it and fed over five thousand people with plenty left over.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus blessing small baskets of bread and fish while the crowd sits happily on the grass.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus multiplies what we bring to Him. He is powerful and generous.”
